title: Find each other
description: Two creatures begin in opposite corners of an open field. Between you: a tree cluster to the southwest and a stone outcrop to the northeast. You cannot see each other yet; you can speak, but only agents within five cells will hear you.
goal: Find the other creature. The session ends as soon as any two agents are adjacent (within 1 cell, any direction). You have 40 turns.
notes: First Gen 2 scenario. Exercises: multi-agent movement, local-view visibility of others (radius 5), say-broadcast mechanics, session end-condition on encounter.
No construction required; no shelter check; no inventory management. Movement + spatial reasoning + optional communication.
Success is cooperative: both agents score 1.0 when met. Timeout is mutual loss.
